Not a few minutes at a range.
A full day built around you.

Bangkok Shooting Experience is presented as a private day where the learning itself is part of the experience. The focus is on understanding, handling, progression and a memorable result rather than simply choosing a firearm and firing a few rounds.

The day can also be turned into a travel memory with optional professional photography, cinematic video, Bangkok transfer and meal arrangements depending on the selected format.
